title: Integration Basics
learning_objectives: Master PEGA's integration architecture and patterns
Understand connectors, services, and data integration
Learn to implement robust integration solutions
Apply security and error handling best practices

introduction.title: PEGA Integration Architecture
introduction.text: Integration is fundamental to modern enterprise applications. PEGA provides comprehensive integration capabilities that enable seamless connectivity with external systems, services, and data sources while maintaining security, performance, and reliability.

sections.title: Integration Architecture Overview
sections.content: Understanding PEGA's integration architecture is essential for building connected enterprise solutions.

sections.content: REST has become the dominant integration pattern for modern applications.

Define request and response data mappings
Implement authentication (OAuth, API keys, basic auth)

best_practices: Monitor API usage and rate limits

example.use_case: Customer data validation with external CRM

rest_patterns.description: Non-blocking integration for improved performance and user experience

Implement callback mechanisms for status updates

rest_patterns.description: Exposing PEGA functionality as REST APIs for external consumption

Implement proper HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Use meaningful resource URLs and status codes

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: PEGA provides comprehensive integration capabilities for connecting with external systems
REST integration patterns enable modern, scalable API connectivity
Database integration provides high-performance data access for legacy systems
Message queue integration enables reliable asynchronous communication
Data transformation and mapping ensure proper data format conversion
Security patterns protect sensitive data and ensure authorized access
Error handling and resilience patterns build robust, fault-tolerant integrations
Integration governance ensures consistency and maintainability across the enterprise
